patch.value: Lifecycle policy gate measures nothing: 23 of 23 fleet repos declare zero policies

On each of the 23 fleet repos run: pm schema policies --json. Observe {policies:[], enforcement:advise}. Then run: pm ops validate --check-completeness --json. Observe violation_count: 0 despite the repo holding items that lack resolution, repro_steps, acceptance_criteria, etc. On a throwaway workspace: pm schema policy-put completeness-feature --definition '{"id":"completeness-feature","effect":"refuse","description":"x","subject":{"types":["Feature"],"statuses":["closed"]},"rule":{"kind":"require_fields","fields":["acceptance_criteria","expected_result"]}}' --author pi-agent; pm schema policy-mode refuse --message x --author pi-agent; pm create Feature --title t --author pi-agent; pm close <id> --reason x --author pi-agent -> exit 4, code workflow_policy_refused.

Every fleet repo declares the canonical lifecycle policy set at enforcement:refuse so that pm ops validate --check-completeness reports violations only when an item genuinely lacks its required evidence, and a closed item without a resolution is refused rather than silently accepted.
